notes.title: Nuckelavee Release!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello![/b][/h2]

I've finally released my first game! I really hope you enjoy it. [b]There will be bugs[/b]. I am continuing to work on testing, debugging and improvements, so please keep that in mind, and if you find anything crazy, please let me know: [b]peatfiregames@outlook.com[/b]

[h2]Initial release and first update:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Initial release
[*] Improved enemy AI slighty
[*] Added controls/change log in main menu
[*] Improved particle effects
[*] Added main menu information
[/list]
